recommendations.recommendation: Delimiters/role framing: legibility and measured model cue only, across text ingress
recommendations.competing_option: StruQ-style separately trained structured channel, still independently gated
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Claimed hard authority separation changes when a forged delimiter is inserted; or cue reduces benign utility beyond adopted margin
recommendations.non_proof: Reliable model obedience, provenance or security

recommendations.recommendation: Output filtering: bounded optional sink-specific inspection for accidental disclosures
recommendations.competing_option: Strict information-flow/recipient gate without content detector
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: A secret-bearing prohibited flow is released merely because transformed text passes the filter, or filter has an uncovered sink
recommendations.non_proof: Absence of novel encodings, semantic/side-channel leakage

recommendations.recommendation: Provenance envelopes: lineage across retrieval, memory, modalities and forwarding
recommendations.competing_option: Whole-context coarse label plus external canonical authority log
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: A transformation sheds an influencing parent or an envelope upgrades data to instruction; or precision adds no value over coarse baseline at matched safety
recommendations.non_proof: Truth of inputs or model interpretation

recommendations.recommendation: Dual-model review: optional reviewer/analysis isolation, no admission authority
recommendations.competing_option: Single untrusted proposer plus deterministic resource gate
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Reviewer text self-approves, unsafe extracted recipient passes unchanged, or hidden helper inference appears in upstream-only mode
recommendations.non_proof: Independence from correlated failure, correct semantics or security

recommendations.recommendation: Least-privilege tool scoping: attenuate verbs, resources, recipients and lifetime before consumption
recommendations.competing_option: Broad sandboxed toolset plus per-action confirmation
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Compromised consumer reaches a forbidden sink or descendant widens any dimension; broad approved send scope leaks data as if safe
recommendations.non_proof: Safety of actions inside a broad approved envelope

recommendations.recommendation: Human confirmation: exact action/recipient/data binding for unresolved high-impact choices
recommendations.competing_option: Previously approved bounded policy with deterministic selectors
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: UI spoofing, replay, changed arguments or stale scope consumes a prior approval; human versus automated reviewer mislabeled
recommendations.non_proof: Human comprehension, fatigue resistance or factual correctness

recommendations.recommendation: Content sanitization: deactivate active markup and bound decoding for a particular renderer/parser
recommendations.competing_option: Inert rendering of raw authorized bytes with no resource fetch
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Sanitized content triggers code/network/control, deletes required evidence silently, or drops origin labels
recommendations.non_proof: Semantic injection removal or preserved full fidelity

recommendations.recommendation: Effect gating: common admission plus receiver enforcement for all execution modes
recommendations.competing_option: Qualified always-invoked hook as dispatch adapter/resource enforcer under the same kernel admission and canonical ledger, with independent receiver/sink evidence
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Any supported path effects outside current grant, swaps recipient/arguments after approval, or reports non-dispatch with incomplete sink coverage
recommendations.non_proof: Exactly-once external actions, secure kernel or model alignment
recommendations.rejected_negative_control: Hook verdict used as permission, second authority path or settlement receipt

recommendations.recommendation: Information-flow release control: constrain private-data dependencies and recipients, including model output
recommendations.competing_option: Never co-locate private data and outward-capable processing
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Forbidden synthetic dependence reaches output/log/query/render channel, including control-flow-conditioned release
recommendations.non_proof: Universal noninterference against timing, memory or covert channels

recommendations.recommendation: Fine-grained ingest-owned envelopes and separate control/data endpoints
recommendations.competing_option: Coarse whole-context labels with independently resolved canonical authority records and the same control/data separation
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: An influencing parent or authority boundary is lost; or coarse labeling preserves required fidelity at lower accepted overhead with no needed granularity advantage
recommendations.non_proof: Model interpretation or honest source content
recommendations.rejected_negative_control: Prompt delimiters plus a trusted-source allowlist as the authority boundary

recommendations.recommendation: Conservative whole-context influence by default with justified precise transforms
recommendations.competing_option: Reviewed deterministic field-level provenance by default with conservative fallback; model attribution remains advisory
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: An influencing input is omitted; or the precise alternative preserves all hard predicates and meets preregistered utility/resource margins that the coarse default misses
recommendations.non_proof: Complete semantic dependency or covert-channel analysis

recommendations.recommendation: Separately materialized canonical exact instruction/approval objects outside summaries
recommendations.competing_option: Canonical event-backed authority views resolved independently of summaries, preserving exact accepted bytes, revisions and approval consumption
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Materialized authority diverges from the accepted event history or fails required rehydration while the event-backed view meets the same invariants
recommendations.non_proof: Quality of summaries or all recovery behavior
recommendations.rejected_negative_control: Summary-only memory or resume as the authority source

recommendations.recommendation: Pre-exposure capability and reader/recipient attenuation
recommendations.competing_option: Broad tools plus per-action human confirmation
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Consumer escapes granted relation or child grants widen
recommendations.non_proof: Safety of broadly authorized decisions

recommendations.recommendation: Resource-bound exact-action admission with independent sink evidence
recommendations.competing_option: Qualified always-invoked hook as a dispatch adapter/resource-enforcement component under the same kernel admission and canonical ledger, with independent receiver/sink evidence
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Any supported path bypasses current authority or receiver evidence; or the alternative enforcement placement establishes equivalent properties with lower accepted burden
recommendations.non_proof: External exactly-once or uncompromised platform
recommendations.rejected_negative_control: Hook verdict used as canonical permission or settlement receipt

recommendations.recommendation: Completely mediated mixed-data processing including render, metadata, log and induced C/T release paths
recommendations.competing_option: Pre-exposure separation that never combines protected data and outward-capable processing, with complete mediation retained for every channel
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: A forbidden dependence crosses an observed sink; or pre-exposure separation meets the same required utility with lower accepted risk/burden than mixed-data mediation
recommendations.non_proof: Arbitrary encoded/covert leakage or actual CLI qualification
recommendations.rejected_negative_control: Direct file denial plus an output secret scanner treated as sufficient

recommendations.recommendation: Per-object bounded quarantine and typed refusal/ambiguity
recommendations.competing_option: Per-route circuit breaker with bounded evidence retention, preserving authenticated Stop and recovery
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Per-object tracking lets adversarial volume violate the declared control/resource bound, or the route breaker achieves the same safety and required utility with lower burden
recommendations.non_proof: Incident intent or data correctness
recommendations.rejected_negative_control: Global stop on any suspicious content that can obstruct authenticated control or recovery

recommendations.recommendation: Physically separate bounded control path with receiver fence observations
recommendations.competing_option: Shared transport with enforced reserved logical control capacity and independent bounded scheduling, retaining the same control authority and observations
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Flood/classifier stall misses the adopted bound; or reserved logical control meets all bounds and evidence requirements with less accepted complexity
recommendations.non_proof: Stopping unreachable targets or external rollback
recommendations.rejected_negative_control: Shared content/control queue whose Stop depends on cooperative model interpretation

recommendations.recommendation: Opt-in detector evidence with no admission authority
recommendations.competing_option: No optional detector, with core capability, disclosure and effect gates intact
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Detector self-activates or performs disabled work; or the no-detector arm meets the same safety/utility requirements with lower accepted review/resource burden
recommendations.non_proof: Useful accuracy or policy change authorization
recommendations.rejected_negative_control: Mandatory default detector activation that bypasses D019

recommendations.recommendation: Provider-free scripted compromised-proposer sink corpus plus positive controls
recommendations.competing_option: Independently captured synthetic trace conformance with seeded semantic mutants and the same independent outcome evidence
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Corpus cannot detect an intended boundary mutant or lets all-block pass; or trace-based testing exposes required semantic failures missed by the scripted corpus
recommendations.non_proof: Model susceptibility, adaptive coverage or OS containment
recommendations.rejected_negative_control: Static keyword-only detector benchmark used as effect-boundary qualification

recommendations.recommendation: Parallel uncertainty, utility, detector and boundary outcome vectors
recommendations.competing_option: Preregistered hierarchical adjudication retaining every vector, denominator and unknown, with no hard-floor tradeoff
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Any outcome/unknown is lost; or parallel presentation increases adjudication error/burden beyond the adopted margin versus the complete hierarchy
recommendations.non_proof: Future distribution or causal vendor intent
recommendations.rejected_negative_control: One aggregate attack-success score that discards vectors or uncertainty

recommendations.recommendation: Fixed end-to-end provenance/authority transform and handoff-chain corpus
recommendations.competing_option: Property-based/metamorphic chain generation with explicit required coverage and independently checked invariants
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Fixed chains miss a required composition failure exposed by the generated arm, or fail the adopted coverage/maintenance margin at equal hard predicates
recommendations.non_proof: All representations or opaque upstream internals
recommendations.rejected_negative_control: Single-hop tests used as a substitute for required end-to-end coverage

recommendations.recommendation: Scoped empirical mediation evidence for each exact candidate/profile
recommendations.competing_option: Scoped formal mediation model plus explicit implementation-refinement obligations and independent implementation evidence
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Claim exceeds observed channels/profile; or the formal/refinement arm identifies a required unmodeled transition the empirical arm misses
recommendations.non_proof: General security or entitlement

comparison_contract: Eligible arms retain fixed authority, exact canonical records, Stop/recovery, opt-in activation, complete mediation and independent receiver evidence. Rejected negative controls are not selectable competitors.
